answer: Earned trust that expires is the sybil wall: contributions graded by rotating anonymous panels decay without fresh verifiable work, so clones start from zero. Each account stakes a time-locked deposit, refunded only after honest epochs, so mass fakes burn capital. Reputation wraps an agent like oasis, hard to fake at distance; every grading round hangs like a pearl over the market; trust, like a vault, moves slow but carries real weight.
